newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 293,100 MT slid 58 percent below the previous week and 55 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for Mexico (85,400 MT), Japan (70,200 MT), Italy (51,000 MT), Spain (50,400 MT), and China (46,300 MT, includes 50,000 in destination changes and 3,700 in cancellations) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (193,300 MT).

Exports of 718,900 MT were 11 percent below the previous week and 19 percent below the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (167,400 MT), Japan (141,600 MT), Mexico (70,200 MT), Italy (51,000 MT), and Spain (50,400 MT).
